major_cooldowns.name: Dragonrage
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every 2 minutes on a target that will live 30+ sec, line your potion and on-use trinkets up with it once Rising Fury is at 4+ stacks, and extend the window with empowers while Essence Burst is guaranteed.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Always release at empower rank 1, refresh it as soon as the damage over time is refreshable, and stop spending it in the last 6 GCDs before Dragonrage so it is banked to extend the window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 382266 is the observed cast id (67 casts in the sampled parse); the guide and APL reference 357208, with 357209 / 1283718 / 1283719 as further same-name variants.

major_cooldowns.name: Eternity Surge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Rank 1 in single target; in AoE match the rank to the pack, 2/4/6 targets per empower level, or fire it instantly with Tip the Scales, then spend the Azure Sweep charges it grants.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 359073 is the guide's id and the only Eternity Surge id carrying a parse-cast source; 359077 and 382411 are same-name variants seen only in the APL.

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold it for Dragonrage and spend it on whichever empower comes up first inside the window, usually Eternity Surge at maximum rank.

major_cooldowns.name: Deep Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Scalecommander only: open with it and cancel the moment you reach the target, then send the Strafing Run follow-up 7-8 sec later once you have spent at least two Imminent Destruction charges, and in AoE only once the pack is grouped.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 357210 is the targeted castable version; 353759, 433874 and 1236943 are same-name variants referenced by the APL.

rule.description: Dragonrage into Eternity Surge, then Disintegrate
rule.action: Pre-cast Living Flame, then open Dragonrage, empowers at rank 1, and only then start chaining Disintegrate. Scalecommander leads with a cancelled Deep Breath before Dragonrage.

rule.description: Bank Fire Breath and Eternity Surge for Dragonrage
rule.action: With Animosity, stop spending empowers roughly 6 GCDs before Dragonrage. Each empower cast inside the window extends it by 5 sec, which is how you reach 34 sec Dragonrages.
Both share a 2 minute cooldown, so never spend Tip the Scales outside Dragonrage. Use it on the first empower up in the window, normally Eternity Surge at max rank.
Spend Essence on Pyre from 3 targets as Flameshaper and from 4 as Scalecommander. Below that, and on any priority target, Disintegrate is the spender.

rule.description: Essence Burst spent on Disintegrate or Pyre
rule.action: Cash Essence Burst into a free Disintegrate, or Pyre in AoE, before it expires. Inside Dragonrage every filler procs it, so spend it rather than stacking fillers.

rule.description: Living Flame is the filler under Leaping Flames
rule.action: Cast Living Flame at least once between every Fire Breath so no Leaping Flames goes unconsumed. Azure Strike is the filler only when you are moving with no Hover.

rule.description: Living Flame over Azure Strike on Burnout
rule.action: Burnout makes Living Flame free and instant, so it is the filler for every stack. Drop to Azure Strike only with neither Burnout nor Leaping Flames up.
